user.title: DWZ Configuration
user.description: Enter the NuLiga ID of the player. You can find it via the DWZ search: https://www.schachbund.de/dwz-spieler.html. Search results include links that contain the NuLiga ID, e.g. https://www.schachbund.de/dwz-spieler/NU4168433.html — copy the ID (e.g. 'NU4168433').

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the DWZ service. Please check your network and try again.
error.missing_dependency: Required dependency missing (dwzclient). Please install the integration dependencies.
error.not_found: No player found for the given NuLiga ID. Please verify the ID and try again.
